title: v2.1.247
content: What's changed Added the SendFeedback tool: when something goes wrong in a session, Claude can draft a feedback report for you to review and send from /feedback (turn off with the feedbackDrafts setting) Added {id, text, cooldownSessions, priority} entries, tipsFile , and label to spinnerTipsOverride , so organizations can rotate their own tips alongside the built-in ones Added a tip on Bash permission prompts pointing to auto mode, with a one-keystroke "Yes, and switch to auto mode" option Added /claude-api cost-optimize to profile an existing project's Claude API spend and work through cost levers (caching, token hygiene, batch, effort, model choice) one measured change at a time Updated the /claude-api skill with Admin API coverage (organization members, invites, workspaces, API keys, rate limit reports, workload identity federation, CMEK) Fixed fast arrow-key + Enter sequences acting on the row above the one you navigated to in history search, /config , /mcp , /skills , background
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.247 版本更新，新增 SendFeedback 工具（出错时自动起草反馈报告供 /feedback 提交）、可定制的 spinnerTipsOverride 组织级提示轮播，以及 Bash 权限提示中一键切换 auto 模式的选项。同时新增 /claude-api cost-optimize 命令，用于分析项目的 Claude API 成本并逐项优化（缓存、token 精简、批处理、effort 与模型选择），/claude-api skill 也扩展了 Admin API 覆盖。

title: Quoting Paul Dix
content: The fact that AI wrote 1M LOC and then refined it over the course of the next couple of months to produce a reliable piece of software that is currently running on millions of developer machines is absolutely mind blowing. And you can say, “well it’s not that impressive because they had an oracle to compare against, so it was simple to go from one language to another”, but I think that’s selling this entire thing short. If you can build a verification system and give proper direction, AI can produce a highly complex, highly sophisticated piece of software and it can continue to refine it until it just works. — Paul Dix , The end of programming Tags: coding-agents , ai-assisted-programming , generative-ai , bun , ai , llms
summary_zh: Paul Dix 评论 Bun 团队用 AI 生成百万行代码并持续迭代数月，最终产出运行在数百万开发者机器上的可靠软件。核心观点是：只要能建立可验证的校验系统并给出恰当的方向指引，AI 就能持续打磨出高度复杂的软件。这对 Claude Code 等编程代理的实践启示是——投资于验证闭环比单纯改进提示更重要。

title: Lovable CTO: The Future of SaaS Is Apps That Agents Can Use
content: Lovable is branching out from AI-powered web app creation and into MCP-powered ‘capabilities’. We talk to CTO Fabian Hedin.

title: Demystifying Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Language Models
content:
arXiv:2608.24949v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has emerged as a powerful framework for enhancing the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), enabling impressive reasoning, math, and coding capabilities. Yet for many researchers and practitioners, the principles behind classical RL remain a "black box". In this work, we deconstruct the RL post-training algorithm, investigating each step to clarify what is actually happening beneath the surface. By isolating the mechanics of RL with Verifiable Rewards in a controlled and simplified environment, we examine how RL outcomes are shaped by the base model's prior distribution, the granularity of the reward signal, the diversity of the prompt distribution, and model scale. We use the entropy of the policy's output distribution as a lens to compare the distributions learned through pretraining, SFT, and RL post-training, revealing how each stage shapes model certainty. title: [AINews] 10% worse, 100x cheaper, 10000x faster: Why Simulation is taking over
content: Did you think RSI stopped at model training?
summary_zh: 本期 AINews 探讨「模拟」（Simulation）正成为 AI 训练与推理的主导范式：用质量仅差 10% 但成本低 100 倍、速度快 10000 倍的模拟环境替代真实环境，并延伸到递归自我改进不止于模型训练阶段的观点。对关注 LLM 训练范式、Agent 环境构建与合成数据工作流的开发者有参考价值，但内容偏行业趋势而非可直接落地的编程工具技巧。

title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
content: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory across chat and Cowork, so users no longer have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects, preferences, and other context.
author: Sarah Perez
summary_zh: Anthropic 为 Claude 打通了 chat 与 Cowork 之间的共享记忆，用户不再需要反复向 AI 交代项目背景、偏好等上下文。这对跨场景的长期 AI 工作流是实质性的上下文管理改进，可减少重复 prompt 成本。

title: How loveholidays is making everyone a builder with Codex
content: Discover how loveholidays uses OpenAI Codex to make software development accessible across the business, helping teams turn ideas into products faster.
summary_zh: 案例文章介绍旅游电商公司 loveholidays 如何用 OpenAI Codex 让非工程岗位的员工也能参与软件开发，把想法更快变成可用产品。核心价值在于展示 AI 编程工具在企业内部的普及化落地路径与组织协作模式，而非具体技术实现。信息密度偏营销向，实操细节有限。
